Eighteen comments

Bobby Gardiner Composition

I learned this from Bobby Gardiner’s album of the same name. It’s a lovely little tune in which some smart ideas come out of a simple melody.

John Carty also recorded a really nice version of this tune too.

3rd bar (A part)

This tune is a favorite of mine. Lots of room for banjo ornaments, and that D arpeggio in the 3rd bar (which sounds right to me if you compare it to the playing in the video) has kind of a distinctive flair. There’s something going on in the playing on the video in the 2nd-3rd bars of the B part that’s different from the notation, but I’d have to spend some time listening to really figure out what she’s doing. It’s close to the notated version, in any case.

Re: The Clare Shout

Nobody above has actually given Bobby Gardiner the credit as the composer of this jig. It’s on page 113 of his “A Complete Guide To The Irish Button Accordion” book / 3 x CD tutor set.
He says “I wrote this tune in 1995 when Clare won the All-Ireland Senior Hurling title”.
He has it in the key of “C”.
